description: Na₄Sr(SiO₃)₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (2.49 Å) and five longer (2.54 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (2.26 Å) and one longer (2.91 Å) Na-O bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (2.22 Å) and one longer (2.26 Å) Na-O bond length. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.26 Å. Sr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.61-2.84 Å. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 40°. There are two shorter (1.59 Å) and two longer (1.67 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 40°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.67 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 40°. There are two shorter (1.59 Å) and two longer (1.67 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Sr and two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sr, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Sr and two Si atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Sr and two Si atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one Si atom.
